title: Wild Playful Clefairy makes one or two natural in-place hops

verification.actor: One exact current Wild Clefairy with a current Player target and one checked passive Cyndaquil follower.
verification.trigger: Normal neutral frames first admit Find Playmate toward the captured Player, then while-true Playful only at distance0..1 with that parent applied. Native Walk policy uses its normal random draws.
verification.observable: The same Clefairy completes one-hop and two-hop stock sequences. Each count shows and skips both heart and own cry in accepted sequences, with positive vertical arcs at unchanged position and stock control release.

setupMutations.change: Only public teleport, party/follower preparation, Wild spawns, and current identity binds.

limits: The bounded run needs both natural counts, visible effect outcomes, and a declined 60 percent admission; no RNG or timer is written.
This case proves Wild Playful only; mounted chain behavior is separate.

events.value: Observe both natural in-place hop counts, independent heart and cry outcomes, an admission skip, and stock control release.

stop.condition: All exact natural hop, chance, and effect outcomes or first stale boundary.

invariants: Exact current Clefairy, timed Find Playmate, same Player target, and adjacent while-true Playful with applied Find Playmate
Natural 60 percent admission, 50 percent extra hop, and independent 50 percent effect draws
One and two full stock Hop sequences with unchanged position
Visible heart and own cry shown and skipped at the accepted JUMP
